lessonsIntro: The local surf school is Pete's, which teaches from the car park at Westport Beach, a few minutes north of Machrihanish along the same stretch of sand.

text: Machrihanish Bay is a long, open beach on the Atlantic side of Kintyre. It runs north to Westport and picks up swell that wraps in past Islay. Lessons are usually at the Westport end, where Pete's Surf School is based in the car park and teaches all levels. The bay is very exposed, so it can get big and windy, and a coach can help you find the friendliest section.

We couldn't find any lifeguard cover on this stretch. Wild About Argyll advises taking precautions, using the right equipment and asking locals about conditions before you go in. In practice, that means surfing small days, staying away from the rocks at the Machrihanish village end, and never going out alone as a beginner.

cards.text: There are milder conditions in summer. Autumn and winter bring powerful Atlantic swell.

cards.label: Watch out for
cards.title: Exposure, no lifeguards
cards.text: Strong wind, big swell and no lifeguard cover that we could find.

hireIntro: You can hire surf kit from Pete's Surf School in the Westport Beach car park.

text: Beginners should use a large foam board, and improvers can step down on clean days. When the Atlantic swell is up, the bay is best left to experienced surfers. A local guide notes that a warm 5mm wetsuit is the norm here all year. Boots, gloves and hoods are worth having from autumn to spring, and you can hire them from Pete's.

shopsIntro: We couldn't confirm a surf shop in Machrihanish or Campbeltown.
shopsText: Machrihanish is a small village, and Campbeltown is about ten minutes away by car. We couldn't confirm a dedicated surf shop in either. For kit, your best local option is hire from Pete's at Westport. Otherwise, bring what you need with you, as Kintyre is a long drive from the nearest big towns.

lessons.q: Where do surf lessons happen near Machrihanish?
lessons.a: At Westport Beach, from Pete's Surf School in the car park.
We couldn't find any lifeguard cover. Check conditions with locals and surf with a coach if you're new to surfing.

hire.a: Yes. Pete's hires 5mm wetsuits, plus boots, gloves and hoods.

hire.q: Is there hire in Machrihanish village?
hire.a: Not that we could confirm. Pete's at Westport is the local option.
